intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Someone has hung a carved plaque nearby. Kaedra reads it twice. The second time, she reads it like an inspector.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Written by someone who has never met an avalanche.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “*A good bridge flexes.* I submitted it. They said it was not inspiring.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Neither is a bridge in a river.”

options.labelText: “A bridge bends because people are walking on it.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I will submit it under your name. Then you can be told it is uninspiring.”

options.labelText: “I kind of like it, though. Never bend. Very you.”
